### Observed differences

- Activity A02 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it occurs exactly once in every trace (200 of 200), always as the final event of the case (normalized position 1.0 in every trace). [OCC001, POS002]
- Before, A05 was the last activity: it sat at the final position in all earlier traces and had no observed outgoing transitions. In the later window, A05's only observed successor is A02, and A02 runs after A05, A01, A09 and A03 in 100% of traces (and after A06, A07 or A08 in the roughly half of traces containing them). [POS005, DIR002, REL001, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011]
- With the extra final event, every existing activity appears slightly earlier in normalized position: A05 from last (1.0) to about 0.85, A01 from about 0.81 to about 0.69, A09 from about 0.63 to about 0.54, and A04 from about 0.44 to about 0.38. [POS001, POS004, POS005, POS009]
- The split between the two middle branches moved from about 44 in 100 cases taking the A06 path (which includes A08) and 56 in 100 taking the A07 path, to an even 50/50; accordingly, A03's outgoing share to A06 rose from about 39% to 46% and its share to A04 fell from about 18% to 13%. A06 and A07 still never occur in the same trace, so they remain alternatives in both windows. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, REL021]
- A rare back-edge from A08 to A03 became much less frequent, from about 7% to about 1% of A08's outgoing transitions (only a handful of observations in each window), and the lags from A08 to A01, A04, A05 and A09 concentrated further on their dominant values. [DIR005, LAG015, LAG016, LAG017, LAG018]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new final activity, A02, was appended after A05: in the earlier window traces ended with A05 and A02 was never observed, while in the later window every case executes A02 exactly once, directly after A05, making it the new last step. This rests on direct and mutually consistent occurrence, position, direction and relation evidence, and a 0-of-200 to 200-of-200 participation change is not plausibly explained by rare-variant sampling. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that A02 already existed but was never executed before and has now become mandatory in every case; behaviourally the two are indistinguishable here. [OCC001, POS002, DIR002, REL001, REL005, REL007, REL011]

Other differences: the branch choice between the A06 (with A08) path and the A07 path shifted from roughly 44/56 to 50/50, and the rare A08 → A03 back-edge nearly disappeared; both shifts are small and rest on moderate or thin support, so sampling variation within a stable routing mix cannot be ruled out. The uniformly earlier positions of all existing activities mirror the appended final event rather than independent relocations of those activities. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR005, POS001, POS004, POS005, POS009]
